description: This file defines the MD5Crypt class providing methods for key-based encryption, decryption, and generating random passwords, specifically for session management purposes within the ADOdb library.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: A class providing methods for encryption, decryption, and password generation used in session management.

methods.name: keyED
methods.description: Performs an XOR operation between text and an MD5-hashed key.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string with a key, returning a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a base64-encoded string encrypted by Encrypt() back to the original text.

methods.name: RandPass
methods.description: Generates an 8-character random password composed of printable characters.
